Select approved drugs (max_phase_for_ind = 4) with cancer indications. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Filter efo_term containing 'cancer' (case-insensitive). Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
